summary: Bank of Montreal filed a Form 6-K announcing an intention to repurchase up to 25 million common shares (~3.6% of public float) under a normal course issuer bid, subject to OSFI and TSX approval. The bid would run from approximately September 8, 2026 to September 7, 2027, replacing the current NCIB ending September 4, 2026. Shares will be bought at market price on exchanges or via exemptions, with timing at management discretion. No price per share or premium was specified. Watch for regulatory approvals and execution pace; risk-arb angle minimal as this is a routine capital return program.
